product.name: Ninja Crispi Glass Air Fryer, 4-in-1, Grey, FN101GY | Max crisp, bake, air fry, recrisp, 450F max, 4 Qt and 6 Cup Glassware, PFAS-free glass
features: ALL-IN-ONE SYSTEM: Includes the Ninja Crispi PowerPod, 4-qt and 6-cup borosilicate glass containers, and 2 snap-lock storage lids — everything you need to cook, crisp, and store in one compact set.
PORTABLE AIR FRYER POWERPOD: Full air fryer power in a palm-sized, countertop-free design — the only pod-style air fryer that works across multiple container sizes for versatile, go-anywhere cooking.

COOK FOR ONE OR FOUR: 6-cup glass container crisps a personal-sized meal in just 7 minutes; 4-qt container fits a 4-lb whole chicken with vegetables — perfect for meal prep, small-batch cooking, or family dinners.
PFAS-FREE, TOXIN-FREE COOKWARE: CleanCrisp borosilicate glass containers are free of PFAS, PTFE, and nonstick chemical coatings — safe, nontoxic cooking and food storage in one vessel.
4-IN-1 AIR FRYER FUNCTIONS: Max Crisp, Bake, Air Fry, and Recrisp modes let you cook crispy air fryer meals, reheat leftovers to like-new crunch, and bake — all without a full-size oven or air fryer.
COUNTERTOP- AND SURFACE-SAFE: Permanently fixed heat-safe feet protect granite, quartz, marble, butcher block, and laminate surfaces — no trivets, no hot pads needed

LEAK-PROOF MEAL PREP CONTAINERS: Snap-lock lids create an airtight, spill-proof seal so you can prep, cook, and transport meals in the same glass container — ideal for lunch meal prep and on-the-go eating
SPACE-SAVING NESTED STORAGE: The Crispi PowerPod nests inside the CleanCrisp glass containers for compact, cabinet-friendly storage — no wasted drawer space or tangled cords
COMPATIBLE WITH BOTH CONTAINERS: Includes a container adapter so the PowerPod works with both the 6-cup and 4-qt glass containers — one pod, two sizes
DISHWASHER-SAFE EASY CLEANUP: Glass containers, crisper plates, adapter, and lids are all dishwasher safe for fast, effortless cleanup after every use
